title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. The physical/orbital/derived data spine now distinguishes JPL source values, fitted approximate planetary elements, satellite mean elements, explicit proxies and derived values. Eight planet orbits are source-hardened, five dwarf-planet heliocentric a values remain visibly provisional, and a 50-case geophysical evidence matrix/protocol is frozen before coding or QCA inspection.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 was registered 2026-09-24. Pilot-0 froze the 50-body frame and anti-circularity model ladder. Physical-core v0.1 ingested JPL values for 34 cases and source-faithful Margot/Soter code. Pilot-1 built separate orbit and derived-physics layers. Source-hardening v0.2 replaced all eight planet period-derived semimajor axes with JPL approximate J2000 elements (Earth explicitly as EMB proxy), quantified the <0.05% shifts, and froze an unexposed 50-case geophysical evidence-state matrix and operational coding protocol before calibration or QCA solution inspection.

tables.status: case frame + physical + orbit v0.2 + derived v0.2 + evidence-state skeleton
